title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: check writing, ATM access, daily limits and overdraft source eligibility by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference states, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, how money can be taken out of the account (money market checks, ATM card), the daily ceilings on ATM cash and on online or mobile transfers out, and whether the tier may serve as the overdraft protection source of a checking account.

## Definitions

- **Check writing**: whether money market checks can be written on the account.
- **ATM card access**: whether an ATM card can withdraw from the account.
- **ATM daily withdrawal limit**: the most cash that can be withdrawn at ATMs per calendar day, in USD; USD 0.00 where there is no ATM access.
- **Online transfer daily limit**: the most value that can be transferred out through online or mobile banking per calendar day, in USD.
- **Overdraft protection source**: whether the tier may be linked as the overdraft protection source of a checking account.

## Tier table

| Tier | Check writing | ATM card access | ATM daily withdrawal limit | Online transfer daily limit | Overdraft protection source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | no | yes | USD 500.00 | USD 5000.00 | eligible |
| Statement Savings | no | yes | USD 500.00 | USD 10000.00 | eligible |
| Goal Builder Savings | no | no | USD 0.00 | USD 5000.00 | not eligible |
| Money Market Account | yes | yes | USD 800.00 | USD 25000.00 | eligible |
| Premier Money Market | yes | yes | USD 1000.00 | USD 50000.00 | eligible |
| Private Client Money Market | yes | yes | USD 2500.00 | USD 250000.00 | eligible |

## The same facts by question

- **Which tiers allow money market checks?** Money Market Account, Premier Money Market and Private Client Money Market. Starter Savings, Statement Savings and Goal Builder Savings do not.
- **Which tier has no ATM access?** Goal Builder Savings; its ATM limit is USD 0.00.
- **Which tier cannot be linked as a checking account's overdraft protection source?** Goal Builder Savings. Every other tier can.

## Points of judgement

**A Statement Savings owner wants to move USD 12000.00 out through online banking on one calendar day. Is that within the tier's daily ceiling?** No; the Statement Savings online transfer daily limit is USD 10000.00.

**A Premier Money Market owner withdraws USD 1000.00 in ATM cash on one calendar day. Is that within the tier's ATM ceiling?** Yes; USD 1000.00 does not exceed the tier's USD 1000.00 limit.
